## Construct a median {#fv2-construct-median .fv-lesson .proof-lesson .construction-slide }

```{=html}
<div data-vector-construction="median" data-initial-text="Start with the two known side vectors.">
<p class="construction-given">Let <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=\overrightarrow{AB},\quad \underset{\sim}{b}=\overrightarrow{AC}"></span>.</p>
<div class="construction-layout">
<div class="construction-diagram" role="img" aria-label="Triangle ABC with side vectors a and b."></div>
<ol class="construction-steps" aria-label="Construction working">
<li hidden data-step-text="Go from C to B via A."><span class="construction-step-label">1. Go from C to B via A.</span><span data-math="\overrightarrow{CB}=\overrightarrow{CA}+\overrightarrow{AB}=-\underset{\sim}{b}+\underset{\sim}{a}=\underset{\sim}{a}-\underset{\sim}{b}"></span></li>
<li hidden data-step-text="Halve CB to reach its midpoint M."><span class="construction-step-label">2. Halve CB to reach its midpoint M.</span><span data-math="\overrightarrow{CM}=\tfrac12\overrightarrow{CB}=\tfrac12(\underset{\sim}{a}-\underset{\sim}{b})"></span></li>
<li hidden data-step-text="Go from A to M via C."><span class="construction-step-label">3. Go from A to M via C.</span><span data-math="\overrightarrow{AM}=\overrightarrow{AC}+\overrightarrow{CM}"></span></li>
<li hidden data-step-text="Substitute the two known vectors."><span class="construction-step-label">4. Substitute the two known vectors.</span><span data-math="\overrightarrow{AM}=\underset{\sim}{b}+\tfrac12(\underset{\sim}{a}-\underset{\sim}{b})"></span></li>
<li hidden data-step-text="Simplify: this is the vector from A to the midpoint M."><span class="construction-step-label">5. Simplify: this is the vector from A to the midpoint M.</span><span data-math="\overrightarrow{AM}=\underset{\sim}{b}+\tfrac12\underset{\sim}{a}-\tfrac12\underset{\sim}{b}"></span><span data-math="\phantom{\overrightarrow{AM}}=\tfrac12\underset{\sim}{a}+\tfrac12\underset{\sim}{b}=\tfrac12(\underset{\sim}{a}+\underset{\sim}{b})"></span></li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="construction-controls"></div>
</div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Supports booklet p. 14</div>

::: {.notes}
Take A as the origin, with a=AB and b=AC. Use Next step to trace C→A→B, giving CB=CA+AB=−b+a=a−b. Then mark M halfway from C to B, so CM=(a−b)/2. Trace A→C→M before replacing the two vectors and simplifying. The green arrow is a, gold is b, purple is the side/midpoint construction, and blue is the resulting median vector. The blue arrow ends at M: it is the actual median vector, not just a parallel direction. A scalene triangle distinguishes this median from the altitude and angle bisector. All earlier equations remain visible. Previous step and Reset construction undo the reveals without changing slides.
:::
